editorial.blurb: Ahuevo is an exciting local breakfast spot that elevates simple sandwiches and burgers with locally sourced, high-quality ingredients and fresh-baked bread.
editorial.insiderTip: Order sides like tater tots separately from your sandwich or burger — they don't come as a bundled meal, but the crispy tots are absolutely worth it, and the in-house iced coffee is a standout worth trying.
